laws.statement: portable documents round-trip as plain JSON-compatible data without runtime-only state
one compiled grammar owns validation and authoring capability queries
ordered slots, component versions, cardinality and node references are validated by the durable schema
logical positions remain independent of anonymous text-run identity and map explicitly through edits
operation batches reject atomically and never publish partial document changes
prepared validated state shares unchanged structure while retaining correct indexed node views
an independent non-Sectile consumer can interpret stored documents from public data contracts
configured resource ceilings bound document, schema, string, mark, slot and component-data work before publication
isEqual and isEmpty share exact schema-independent Portable Content helper semantics
